B01_fixed_short_blind.interpretation: Purpose dependence is reproducible: groundwater output can be represented with fewer states than mapped profile fidelity in this bounded laboratory.

B01_fixed_one_day.interpretation: The short-horizon R4 frontier does not persist to one day; horizon and accumulated bias/timing matter.

B14_fixed_one_day.interpretation: B01's R8 minimum is not material-invariant. State count and vertical placement must be treated separately.

B01_dynamic_prescribed_head_blind.structural_response: Strong improvement R3 through R8, then lower-zone response plateau; lower-zone R4/R8 outperform uniform U4/U8.
B01_dynamic_prescribed_head_blind.comparator_warning: R2 misses reversal sequence in 3/4 histories and has 93 sign mismatches, so formal R2 crossing is a weak comparator-relative statement.

B14_dynamic_prescribed_head.formal_C5A_frontier: NONE under frozen all-components R2-relative vector
B14_dynamic_prescribed_head.C5A_blocker: Every lower-zone member fails only pooled absolute mean signed bottom-flux error; R5-R16 plateau.
B14_dynamic_prescribed_head.comparator_pathology: R2 pooled signed bias is cancellation-dominated while history-specific errors are much larger.
reference_audit: C5C-C5I show the original 10-cm R16 Reference is strongly spatial-resolution dependent for this prescribed-head workload.
C5J-C5K establish lower-boundary sensitivity but do not support any tested counterfactual as a justified replacement.
C5L shows unchanged Reference spatial refinement recovering strongly at R2048: R1024-R2048 RMSE 0.00742446 versus R512-R1024 0.0233969, ratio 0.317, descriptive order 1.656.
R2048 is not continuum truth and its temporal error is not independently qualified.
B14_dynamic_prescribed_head.interpretation: C5A remains a valid result under its frozen comparator and metric vector, but its absence of a frontier is not portable as an absolute statement about B14 dynamic-head Layer-ROM sufficiency.

universal_minimum_layer_count.reason: Minimum comparator-relative state dimension changes with material, boundary semantics, horizon, purpose and comparator strength.

evidence: C4X B14 fixed: lower-zone R4/R8 retain groundwater frontier while uniform U4/U8 do not retain the stronger FMC frontier.
C4Z B01 dynamic: lower-zone R4 and R8 outperform matched uniform controls.
C5A B14 dynamic: R4 remains componentwise no worse than U4 and R8 no worse than U8 despite no formal overall frontier.
vertical_placement.conclusion: Where state is retained is at least as important as nominal state count for groundwater-oriented response.

evidence: C4R FMC groundwater minimum R4 versus FMC profile minimum R12.
C4X B14 fixed groundwater minimum R3 versus FMC profile minimum R8.
C4V mapped profile fidelity continues to improve beyond the one-day GW minimum R8.
purpose_dependence.conclusion: Groundwater-output fidelity and profile/process fidelity require distinct representation envelopes.

horizon_dependence.evidence: C4R short B01 fixed minimum R4 becomes C4V one-day persistent minimum R8.
horizon_dependence.conclusion: Memory sufficiency cannot be specified without a prediction horizon.

material_boundary_interaction.evidence: The complete B01/B14 x fixed/dynamic program shows different frontier behavior across cells; C5A differs qualitatively from C4Z while C4X differs from C4V.
material_boundary_interaction.conclusion: Material and lower-boundary semantics interact; neither material-only nor boundary-only rules explain required representation.

fixed_partition_scalar_closure_retuning.conclusion: Current evidence does not justify more scalar tuning of the same fixed-partition closure.

coarse_C5A_dimension_thresholds.conclusion: C5A's no-frontier decision is retained exactly but cannot define a high-resolution B14 dynamic-head minimum.

rationale: It is the only tested fixed-layer topology with placement advantages replicated across material/boundary cells.
Uniform partitions repeatedly waste state relative to lower-zone-focused partitions for groundwater response.
A single fixed universal dimension is contradicted by material and horizon transfer evidence.
representation_implication.note: The ladder is diagnostic coverage, not an a priori claim that all dimensions remain scientifically viable.

unresolved_scientific_question.question: On fresh blind B14 dynamic prescribed-head histories, which lower-zone-focused representations remain competitive with high-resolution Richards controls for groundwater response and profile fidelity once Reference numerical resolution is made explicit?
why_required: C5A is the only B14 dynamic cell but its gate is cancellation-sensitive and its R16 Reference was later shown to be coarse.
Placement transfer is robust, but B14 dynamic state-dimension sufficiency is still unresolved.
This question is representation science and does not require external application acceptance.

mandatory_design: Use fresh B14 dynamic prescribed-head histories not previously exposed to LARE candidates.

Generate matched current-Reference R512, R1024 and R2048 controls on the fresh histories under one prospectively frozen temporal route; include an explicit temporal-resolution control sufficient to characterize numerical Reference uncertainty.
Treat the finest Reference as finest-available numerical control, not continuum truth.
Evaluate groundwater-response and profile/process views separately.
Do not reuse C5A pooled signed-bias gate as an acceptance rule; report per-history signed bias and cancellation explicitly.
Use comparator-relative reference-resolution frontiers rather than application-acceptance thresholds.
Retain lower-zone ladder and matched placement controls without response-based repartitioning.
No closure tuning, no boundary counterfactual, no production Reference change.
Application acceptance remains C4U-blocked; no speed or production claim.
next_authority.stop_condition: If fresh high-resolution evidence still cannot distinguish a representation frontier without an externally governed purpose threshold, stop at a purpose-dependent candidate set rather than inventing a universal minimum.

application_boundary.implication: C5M/C5N may establish scientific representation fidelity but cannot declare groundwater application acceptance.
